newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo says gets FDA approval for diabetes drug.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo says gets FDA approval for diabetes drug.

text.p: Sankyo Co Ltd said on Monday that it has obtained U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for its diabetes drug, Troglitazone, which is effective in combating insulin resistance.
A Sankyo spokesman said the firm has granted development and marketing rights to Warner-Lambert Co, which plans to start selling the drug in the United States in March or April.
Sankyo expects first-year sales in the United States to reach about 10 billion yen, the spokesman said.
The company plans to start selling the drug in Japan as early as the end of this month, the spokesman said.
It also plans to sell the drug in Europe by the end of this year through Glaxo Wellcome Plc, he said.
